name: ak-marketplace
description: AgentKit - 14 modulare Plugins für Review, Git, Projekt-Management, Code-Verbesserung, Knowledge, React, Security, Notifications, JavaScript, Schreiben, Mods, Cache-Pflege, Session-ID und Verbrauchsanzeige

plugins.name: ak-review
plugins.description: Quality assurance with CodeRabbit review, task completion workflow, and file validation hooks

plugins.name: ak-git
plugins.description: Smart Git operations with intelligent commit messages, conflict resolution, and releases

plugins.name: ak-meta
plugins.description: Project management with changelog generation and session handoff

plugins.name: ak-improve
plugins.description: Code improvement agents for refactoring and performance optimization

plugins.name: ak-knowledge
plugins.description: Solution documentation, knowledge maintenance, and project file management

plugins.name: ak-notifications
plugins.description: Platform-specific notification hooks for permission prompts and idle alerts (macOS)

plugins.name: ak-react
plugins.description: React and Next.js development with best practices, performance optimization, and code quality scanning

plugins.name: ak-security
plugins.description: Security guidelines for secure code, LLM applications, and static analysis with Semgrep

plugins.name: ak-js
plugins.description: JavaScript project configuration doctor — validates package.json, tsconfig, framework configs, and enforces cross-file best practices

plugins.name: ak-writing
plugins.description: Prose quality for German and English text: remove AI-slop patterns from docs, commits, emails, blog posts, and slides without losing facts

plugins.name: ak-mods
plugins.description: Mod switcher: a pane that turns each AgentKit mod on or off for this session, with standard mods that start on in every new chat, and draws the one band they share

plugins.name: ak-keepwarm
plugins.description: Mod: keeps this chat's prompt cache warm with a small ping before it expires (/keepwarm), with a segment in the shared band

plugins.name: ak-session-id
plugins.description: Mod: copies this session's id (/session-id), so another session's agent can be told which one is meant, with a segment in the shared band

plugins.name: ak-usage
plugins.description: Mod: shows how full this session's context is and how much of the 5-hour limit is used, as one compact segment in the shared band
